profile.name: YAN MYOE NAING
profile.tagline: Turning messy data into models, insights and tools people can actually use.
profile.subtitle: Applied AI & Analytics student at Singapore Polytechnic

projects.title: Burmese Classical Poetry Generation
projects.summary: Can a model learn the rhythm and rhyme of classical Burmese verse? I built a syllable-level corpus, compared LSTM and GRU models, and added additive attention over the last four phrases. Write an opening and watch which syllables the attention model looks at.

projects.title: Catch & Go Pilot Location Analysis
projects.summary: I built the Power BI analysis of frequent gamers who play for well-being and wrote the synthesis and rollout recommendation. Our team recommended piloting the game in Hougang, then expanding to Yishun if the pilot succeeds.

projects.title: Pendulum Control with Deep Q-Learning
projects.summary: I trained and tuned a Deep Q-Network to swing a pendulum upright using nine torque choices. Try the trained model against a zero-torque control and test how it handles different gravity settings.

projects.title: Q AI — Trusted AI Answer Checker
projects.summary: I built the React frontend and verdict displays for Q AI, a prototype that checks a simulated bank assistant’s answers against policy. I represented Singapore Polytechnic at OCBC Ignite with Team Quadrant.

projects.title: CLARITY — Agentic AI Insurance Navigator
projects.summary: Team Aspire hackathon prototype: six AI agents support an insurance consultation, with live meeting cues, policy sources, meeting records and customer follow-up. Represented Singapore Polytechnic at the category finals.

projects.title: Library Data Engineering Pipeline
projects.summary: End-to-end pipeline for a library: MySQL operational database, a star-schema data warehouse, and a Bronze/Silver/Gold data lake in Parquet with DuckDB reporting. It validates 12,343 completed loans, and invalid rows go to quarantine instead of being deleted.

projects.title: Library Management Database
projects.summary: A MySQL relational database for members, tiers, staff, books, copies and loans, with SQL queries that check borrowing eligibility and available copies.

projects.title: Machine Failure Detection
projects.summary: Machine learning for detecting industrial equipment failures before they happen.

projects.title: House Price Prediction
projects.summary: A regression project estimating house prices from property features.

projects.title: Customer Clustering
projects.summary: Grouping customers into segments with clustering, using PCA to explore and visualise the groups.

projects.title: Energy Consumption Forecasting
projects.summary: Time-series models forecasting electricity, gas and water consumption.

projects.title: Handwritten Letter Recognition
projects.summary: A CNN trained on EMNIST to recognise handwritten letters, with a drawing demo to test it live.

projects.title: Job Market Application Analysis
projects.summary: Analysing applications, salaries, visibility and demand across job titles.

projects.title: Singapore Graduate Career Outcomes
projects.summary: Exploring Singapore graduate career outcomes by degree and gender, with UiPath automation.

projects.title: Wellness Challenge Game
projects.summary: A strategy game where completing wellness challenges earns points to build cities, recruit armies and form alliances. Full-stack CRUD app with login.
